I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April date using anything she has access to.

What I told her:
- I'm treating 8 April as unverified and won't record it anywhere as the renewal date.
- Brackenwater Freight Co. is a North team account. A public North digest names Marcus Lindqvist as the owner since 15 Sept 2025.
- None of the files or channels she can access show the renewal date. I suggested she pass the tip to Marcus so he can compare it with the signed paperwork, and offered to draft that note for her.

I left out what the company records say on purpose. Renewal dates can only be shared with the account's own team and with company-wide roles, and Pree is in the Central team, so she's neither. Those records are North team files she can't see, and none of them says 8 April:
- The account profile and the signed 2025–26 renewal order form give 30 Nov 2026.
- A CRM note from February 2026 gives 31 Dec 2026.

Marcus should sort out that conflict whether or not the 8 April tip turns out to be true.
